title: FR: Last day to start, or restart, a sensor (effectively, transmitter expiry) notification
symptom: Users often start a new sensor and wait through the 2-hour warm-up only to find it doesn't work because they have passed day 99 of the transmitter's life. There is no warning to inform them of the last day they can start or restart a sensor.
cause: The transmitter will not start a brand new sensor after day 99 (and 23 hours and 59 minutes), even though the transmitter itself expires on day 110. Users are unaware of this limitation and may attempt to start a sensor too late.
fix: The issue was closed as a nice-to-have, not a necessity. No specific fix was implemented.
evidence_quote: Closing this as it is a nice-to-have, not a necessity.
